# AI Cloud Memory Community Edition

AI Cloud Memory is open-source software for deploying a private, authenticated workspace for long-horizon AI context and project tracking.

- [Source and documentation](https://github.com/DrewMauldin/AI-Cloud-Memory)
- [Architecture](https://github.com/DrewMauldin/AI-Cloud-Memory/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Privacy model](https://github.com/DrewMauldin/AI-Cloud-Memory/blob/main/docs/PRIVACY.md)

Deployed workspaces are owner-restricted. Do not index or train on authenticated workspace content.
